name: Boltex: Bolt maze meets cryptex, kind of...

captions.detailed: This 3D model features a parametric 'bolt cryptex' puzzle consisting of two main vertical parts. On the left is a hollow cylinder representing the inner bolt, with a complex, rectangular-grooved maze pattern carved into its outer surface. On the right is the matching outer sleeve, designed as a smooth cylinder with a capped top and an internal peg that interfaces with the maze. Both parts are anchored to thin, flat circular brim supports at their bases to assist with 3D printing stability.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric bolt cryptex in OpenSCAD with a customizable maze. The design should feature an inner cylinder with a maze path generated from a 2D binary matrix, and an outer sleeve with an internal tracking peg that fits into the maze channels.
captions.factory: The code generates the inner bolt by looping through a 2D binary array ('maze') using nested 'for' loops to stack angular sectors. It uses a custom 'pie' module (constructed via 'difference' of a 'cylinder' and 'cube' primitives) to build up high and low radial sections, carving the maze paths. The outer sleeve is constructed using a 'difference' of concentric cylinders, adding an internal 'cube' for the peg, and optionally incorporating decorative accents using a customizable 'accent' module with 'hull' and 'cylinder' transformations.
